Mexican Drug Kingpin Rafael Caro Quintero Dies in Prison

Rafael Caro Quintero, a notorious Mexican drug kingpin and founder of the Guadalajara Cartel, has died in prison. He was 69 years old. Caro Quintero was serving a sentence for the 1985 murder of U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) agent Enrique "Kiki" Camarena. He was arrested in July 2022 in the state of Sinaloa, Mexico, following a joint operation by Mexican marines and the U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF). The circumstances of his death in prison are not immediately clear, but reports indicate a massive police presence at the facility.
